about: Jobs the app can ask Claude to do straight away, through the helper (apps/server). The app sends only the job's name; these words are what Claude follows. See maintainers/SHARED-V4-CHANGES.md.

update-deals.label: updating deals from new call notes
update-deals.prompt: Call notes have just been added to a deal in Pipeline OS. Follow .claude/skills/update-a-deal for every deal in apps/pipeline/data/pipeline.json that has notes waiting (notesInbox items with status waiting). Read context/sales.md first. Be quick and change nothing else.

send-emails.label: sending the emails the person approved
send-emails.prompt: The person has just pressed Send on an email in Pipeline OS. Follow .claude/skills/send-approved-emails: send only the emails in apps/pipeline/data/pipeline.json whose sendStatus is queued, exactly as written, then record what happened. Send nothing else and change nothing else.

research-deals.label: researching people before a call
research-deals.prompt: The person has asked for research in Pipeline OS. Follow .claude/skills/research-a-prospect for every deal in apps/pipeline/data/pipeline.json whose researchRequestedAt is newer than its research (or that has no research). Read context/sales.md first. Change nothing else.
